title: On the Convergence of Continuous-Time AdamW
abstract: arXiv:2611.20437v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Continuous-time AdamW provides a framework for understanding whether an optimizer widely used to train large-scale neural networks settles to an equilibrium or sustains persistent motion. We study this long-time behavior while retaining bias correction and fixed positive weight decay. Under suitable assumptions, we establish that the dynamics are well defined for all time and remain bounded when the decay is sufficiently small. Our main result connects their limiting behavior to the geometry of the objective: trajectories approach a locally invariant manifold whose dimension equals the Hessian nullity along the associated critical component. When critical points are isolated and have at most one such direction, the trajectory converges to a single equilibrium. translated_abstract: 连续时间AdamW为理解广泛用于训练大规模神经网络的优化器究竟会稳定到平衡态还是保持持续运动提供了一个框架。我们在保留偏差修正和固定正权重衰减的条件下研究这种长时间行为。在适当的假设下，我们证明了该动力学对所有时间都有良好定义，并且当权重衰减足够小时保持有界。我们的主要结果将其极限行为与目标函数的几何结构联系起来：轨迹会趋近于一个局部不变流形，其维数等于沿相应临界分量的Hessian零化度。当临界点是孤立的且至多只有一个这样的退化方向时，轨迹收敛到单个平衡点。然而，当存在两个退化方向时，即使目标函数是光滑、严格凸且具有唯一极小值的，有界的持续运动也可能出现。我们还量化了……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文为连续时间AdamW动力学建立了长期行为理论，证明轨迹收敛到维数由Hessian零化度决定的局部不变流形，并揭示当存在两个退化方向时，即使对严格凸函数也会出现有界的持续运动。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes the long-time behavior theory of continuous-time AdamW dynamics, proving that trajectories converge to a locally invariant manifold whose dimension is determined by Hessian nullity, and showing that bounded persistent motion can occur even for smooth strictly convex objectives when two degenerate directions exist.
